one_line: Hotel booking with a verified, guest-approved agent change workflow.

leverage_evidence: Agent reads live reservation and availability and stages a change.

impact_rationale: Travelers face consequential changing inventory and pricing; verified agent-assisted changes address a real trust problem.
impact_evidence: Live availability, cancellation-sensitive reservation changes, and guest approval are central use cases.

creativity_rationale: A visual token canvas designed as a genuinely shared human-agent medium is a novel interaction model pursued across many formats.
creativity_evidence: Unicode/ANSI, Mermaid, Vega-Lite, math, tables, and spatial layouts share one editable canvas.
usability_note: Potentially powerful but the breadth of formats may increase complexity.
red_flags: Frame sheets could not be inspected because vision service was rate-limited.
standouts: Memorable shared visual representation for agent output.

leverage_rationale: Shared structured memory state and enforced uncertainty boundaries make agent collaboration safer and more inspectable than unstructured chat or UI automation.
leverage_evidence: Database constraints, roles, deferred triggers, and a shared command layer prevent autonomous contradiction resolution.

red_flags: Frame sheets could not be inspected because vision service was rate-limited.
standouts: Makes uncertainty a first-class user experience.

one_line: A visible workspace for turning web workflows into typed, human-approved tools.

creativity_rationale: Treating agent capability as a human-approved contract discovered from the visible page is an ambitious and original browser interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Cross-origin boundary is shown rather than bypassed; proposals specify read/change semantics.
usability_note: Approval and live trace support trust, though contract review can be demanding.
red_flags: Frame sheets could not be inspected because vision service was rate-limited.
standouts: Strongest direct argument that WebMCP is a capability and governance layer, not a button API.
advance_reason: Top-tier leverage and unusually complete platform execution.

impact_evidence: Learner recalls in own words; system schedules each concept and explains misses.

standouts: Good division of labor between agent judgment and deterministic scheduling.
